question: Which decision-time measurements add reliable, affordable information for choosing practice allocations that improve final macro success?

objective.metric: equal-weight mean success over four tasks

development.source: E1 A at 200k/400k; E3 B/C at 200k
development.probe_to_historical_outcome_rule: Aggregate probes and historical completions separately within parent and allocation; never arbitrarily pair continuation seeds or splice trajectories.

factor_groups.name: 출발 성능과 취약성
factor_groups.optional_measurement: paired loss of previously successful cases after the shared 4k probe
factor_groups.reject_if: fragility feature adds no held-out selection value beyond initial competence

factor_groups.name: 실제 학습 노출과 replay 지연
factor_groups.reject_if: effect reduces to horizon or has no between-state variation
factor_groups.mechanism_probe: separate task sampling proportions from within-task recent/old age sampling

factor_groups.name: 유용한 경험과 탐험 접근성
factor_groups.control: initial success, recent return, task and sample count
factor_groups.reject_if: more novelty only, without useful progress or held-out prediction

factor_groups.name: 업데이트 방향과 크기
factor_groups.control: actual sampled task mix, current success and F05 critic diagnostics
factor_groups.reject_if: unstable across panels or no incremental value beyond empirical task changes
factor_groups.mechanism_probe: raw versus Adam-aware diagnostic; projection only in a separate norm-controlled learner intervention

factor_groups.name: 학습 신호와 평가 목표의 관계
factor_groups.control: success, reward scale, episode length, exploration policy
factor_groups.reject_if: signal is just reward scale or loss change without selection benefit

factor_groups.name: 신경망 가소성
factor_groups.optional_measurement: held-out response to 20 clone-only diagnostic updates
factor_groups.control: task, initial success, replay coverage and critic reliability
factor_groups.reject_if: dormancy or rank is present but does not explain learning response
factor_groups.mechanism_probe: separate from core allocation; resets change more than plasticity

factor_groups.name: 신호의 재현성과 배분 차이
factor_groups.control: mean predicted gain and per-diagnostic cost
factor_groups.reject_if: uncertainty gate does not improve calibration or net-cost decisions
factor_groups.special_rule: do not reject solely because mean gain R-squared does not improve

factor_groups.name: 배분 강도와 순서
factor_groups.control: same parent, total steps, task totals and continuation seed
factor_groups.reject_if: linear mixture or static allocation suffices in controlled new runs

feature_timing.t0: Only parent state and pretraining history; planned future exposure may be computed from known scheduler.
feature_timing.t4k: Only measurements up to the 4k branch snapshot; all diagnostics charged.
feature_timing.t8k: Optional, same-clock comparator; never call it a 4k feature.
forbidden: 40k observed gain used as an input
future sample counts used for a t0 prediction
old continuation and new probe spliced into a trajectory
collector task label treated as task-specific mixed-batch loss
same parent's checkpoints split across train and test

selection.mandatory_baseline: F01 current task performance, public history, candidate allocation, horizon
selection.model: small regularized linear predictor; fold-local preprocessing; no seed ID feature
selection.factor_addition: one group at a time; at most two predeclared scalar summaries per optional group in the first screen
selection.primary_screen_metric: held-out chosen-allocation macro success difference versus matched-information baseline

development_threshold_proposal.meaning: operational triage proposal, not a significance threshold

confirmation.precision_rule: Recalculate required original-seed count before unblinding from development paired variance and a predeclared 2pp practical target; eight is a costing example, not guaranteed power.
confirmation.feature_confirmation: predeclared ablations, simultaneous uncertainty for up to three retained groups; overlap with zero means unresolved, not proof of no effect

feasible_diagnostic_example.development_downsampling: Predetermined outcome-independent two-case subsets per task; assess small-bank predictions and decision gates before confirmation; subset draws are not independent pretrained policies.

online.horizon_and_action_caveat: Forty-k fixed-allocation prediction does not validate 32k/36k or switched-action outcomes. Interpolation is an explicit assumption tested by G4; any F08 new actions need separately budgeted confirmation cells.
online.success_rule: positive primary paired interval versus the strongest development-frozen comparator and practically material gain; report all comparators, absolute gain, and factor ablations as separate optional costs.

factor8_pilot.scope: three named development states, two fixed task identities per composition, eight cells; dose .4375 versus pair-static .375/.375 controls distinct; actual sequential learner states, no spliced independent branches
